verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury publishes an API reference for its core objects: FinancialAccount at docs.stripe.com/api, plus OutboundPayment, ReceivedDebit and Transaction objects. Its integration guides show financial accounts and money movement being driven programmatically, and a community thread describes Shopify building on the Treasury API. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration beyond a Stripe PM's description.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Stripe Treasury for Platforms provides users with a container for money called a FinancialAccount that is separate from their Payments balance.
OutboundPayment objects represent push-based transfers from: A platform’s financial accounts to a financial account owned by connected accounts.
Every movement of funds into or out of a financial account creates a Transaction object.
Send funds from a Stripe payments balance | Instant | Stripe API
Shopify building Balance with the Treasury API so merchants can manage revenue and spend in one place
